questions.q: Are you comfortable to work in a stock exchange, bank or company, or any such place where you have to constantly deal with money transaction, finance, financial policies and its current value?

Are you comfortable to constantly listen to people who are undergoing stress due to some or the other reason in their academic, personal or professional lives, empathize with them and reassure them about the goodness of life?
Are you comfortable to cover any recent news, event, innovation or development and write or broadcast it to the world?
Are you comfortable to conceptualize creative ideas and present them to public in various creative formats such as Video, Audio, Photograph or an article?
Are you comfortable to work on making people look beautiful, change their hairstyle, and give them beauty tips?
Are you comfortable working in isolation and arrange, maintain and manage list of things in an organized manner?
Are you comfortable to be in a role where you have to take responsibilities of your own working as well as the work of others, direct a group of people so that they reach to some common goals?
Are you comfortable in dealing with govt. rules and regulations, policies, acts and laws and incorporate them in day to day life?
Are you comfortable to work non-stop for long hours to reach up to the position where you can work on policies for betterment of country and society?
Are you comfortable to get up at 04:00 AM for early hour practice of your favorite sport, stay on a restricted diet, be open to play in all weather conditions and do lot of physical exertion?
Are you comfortable to walk around smiling all the time, always ready to please people, demonstrate high energy and enthusiasm, to serve and take care of guests?
Are you comfortable in traveling frequently, managing ticket transportation or hotel booking as per clients budget and time and always be willing to help travellers with a smile?
Are you comfortable in being amidst younger group of people, sharing and imparting knowledge to them, solving their curiosities, and being a disciplinary role model for them?
Are you comfortable to learn different languages of the world, watch regional documentaries, read the literatures written in various languages and translate some of them in your own mother tongue?
Are you comfortable to manipulate with fonts, colors and textures, to design different landscapes and characters on computers and work for long hours with concentration?
Are you comfortable to work with various materials, colors and designs, to create every time a new style of dress or jewel according to the latest trends?
Are you comfortable to research about ancient India and the Contemporary world, study about museum artifacts, visit places like Harappa and Egypt and write about events that happened centuries ago?
Are you comfortable to research about the types of soil in different regions of India, explore dormant volcanoes of the world and forecast about weather conditions?
Are you comfortable to understand and analyze the political situation of the world and listen and read news daily to update yourself about what all is happening around?
